title: Self-retracting tether reel concept spec
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Slack is the dominant load variable; self-retracting inertia-locking tethers are preferred (concepts.md). Depends on: ridebelt-retractor-001 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write a concept spec for the tether reel: locking principle, lock-up distance target (≤ 2 cm), retraction force, housing envelope, strength when locked (30 kN MBS), absorber integration, and failure modes.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses retractor-001 findings and states its FTO checks
Each target traces to REQ-L2/L4 or analysis
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
